title: The Evacuation Ferry Allocation
statement:
You are given an array of N people's weights and an integer Limit representing the maximum weight carrying capacity of a rescue boat.
Each boat can carry at most 2 people at the same time, provided the sum of their weights is at most Limit.

Determine the minimum number of boats required to carry every person safely.
inputFormat:
First line: Two integers N and Limit.
Second line: N space-separated integers representing people weights.
outputFormat: Print the minimum number of boats.

sampleCases.explanation: Each in own boat (limit exceeded if paired).
